checked_edges.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-2842
checked_edges.description: The native Pseudomonas putida CatA object combines historical enzyme discussion with a now-deleted Q9AEQ0 pointer. No current UniProt replacement is selected. The native-linked AY029000.1/AAK33066.1 deposit identifies Pseudomonas putida without a strain qualifier; its relationship to the mt-2 CatA preparation cloned in PMID7646060 is unestablished. The paper's mt-2 preparation remains separate from C-1 alpha-alpha, alpha-beta and beta-beta isozymes in PMID2295613 and their method-dependent masses. Table II measures approximately one iron atom per enzyme complex, not per subunit, with pH optimum 7.5; it does not establish an exact ferric chemical species here. PMID7646060 reports 98% amino acid identity between its mt-2 CatA and C-1 beta CatA preparations; this comparison is not transferred to AY029000.1/AAK33066.1. The unstable, partially purified B13 dioxygenase II in PMID697765 is another preparation. PDB 2AZQ/Q51433 is C-1 context, not a replacement for the deleted native pointer. Structured database annotations, separately scoped to their cited preparations: physiologically-relevant = true.
